events.title: Tactical Assessment Manual - The Light's Respite File
events.description:
Rating Missions are divided into daily, round, and manual missions. Completing these missions grants Intel Value to raise your rating level, and reaching corresponding levels grants the matching rewards.
• The Tactical Assessment Manual: The Light's Respite File features Encrypted Intel (30 Rainbow Cards) and Top-Secret Intel (68 Rainbow Cards).
• Encrypted Intel and Top-Secret Intel are mutually exclusive tiers and can be purchased independently.

events.title: Endeavorer's Charm
events.description:
Endeavorer's Charm is the Trial Stage for Leia: Fortunaster, where you can learn the basic controls of the new character Leia: Fortunaster.
⟦d.efReq|Clear Normal Story 1-8⟧

events.title: 7-Day Sign-In Rewards
events.description:
Sign in for a total of 7 days during the event to claim all rewards, including Basic Construct R&D Tickets.
⟦d.efReq|Commandant Lv.20 or above⟧

events.title: Astral Obscura: Boss Challenge
events.description:
This high-difficulty challenge consists of 5 distinct difficulty tiers. You will battle against the Boss Polarized Pterygota Queen.
⟦d.efReq|Commandant Lv.40 or above⟧
• Defeated characters will respawn during the challenge.
• Each stage features a 3-star objective. Accumulate 15 stars to claim all Collectible rewards.

events.title: Munchy Pixels
events.description:
The event has a total of 9 stages.
• Control Leia to dodge viruses, collect scattered pixel beans, and clear viruses with specific items to complete the challenges.
• Clear the designated challenges to complete missions and claim rewards such as Event Construct R&D Tickets and Trade Vouchers.

events.title: Dreamhouse Tycoon
events.description:
Manage the Kuroro Building to earn Dream Funds and complete Building Orders to claim rewards.
• After earning enough Dream Funds, you will also gain Promotion Merit, which can raise staff levels and enhance their skills.
• Plan wisely based on staff skills to earn more Dream Funds.

events.title: Dreamscape Disequilibrium
events.description:
Explore Leia's spiritual world and complete the trial of the Beauty Sefirah.
• Convert your characters and buffs into "Wish Weights," and the enemy's units and buffs into "Cost Weights." Weigh your choices on the scale to achieve mass balance.
• The balancing result will alter the combat effects within the stage. Clearing a stage with a perfect balance increases Wish Mass.
